'''2006 Florida State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship announced for Saturday 17 June 2006 at Coliseum of Comics, 4722 Orange Blossom Trail, Orlando, Florida, with [[John Yakulevich]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-10110-138989">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=138989#138989 Florida States and Dagobah Regionals], John Yakulevich (rancor34), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617234913/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10110&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref> The winner was to design a [[Virtual cards|virtual card]] and receive a bye into Day 2 of the [[2006 World Championship|World Championship]], then planned for Gen Con.<ref name="pcf-10110-138989" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Coliseum of Comics, 4722 Orange Blossom Trail, Orlando, Florida<ref name="pcf-10110-138989" />
* '''Dates:''' 17 June 2006<ref name="pcf-10110-138989" />
* '''Schedule:''' registration 10:00–10:30 am; constructed tournament 10:30 am – 4:30 pm; prize distribution 4:30–5:00 pm; final confrontation (#1 against #2) from 5:00 pm<ref name="pcf-10110-138989" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, six games; decklists and solid-back (non-clear) sleeves mandatory<ref name="pcf-10110-138989" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $15<ref name="pcf-10110-138989" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[John Yakulevich]]<ref name="pcf-10110-138989" />
* '''Prizes:''' uncut sheets, booster packs, tournament foils, posters and pins, two six-month DeckTech premium memberships and bonus [[Young Jedi]] booster packs; a virtual card design and a Day 2 World Championship bye for the winner<ref name="pcf-10110-138989" />

== Organization ==

The same announcement gave Sunday 9 July 2006 as the date of the Dagobah Regionals.<ref name="pcf-10110-138989" />

== Results ==

No results were posted in the forum topic as captured on 17 June 2006.
